blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu – The Lambo Mabolo of Barangay Mabolo in Cebu City has announced its participation in the Sinulog Festival 2027. The barangay’s public information office made the announcement on Thursday, October 22. “Prititit… Dala ang garbo, talento, ug kadasig sa mga Mabolohanon, opisyal nang moapil ang Lambo Mabolo sa umaabot nga Sinulog 2027!” it said in an advisory.
